summary: Restores from backup are for SuperAdmins and are fully audited.

fixes.title: Restore from backup is SuperAdmin only
fixes.text: Restoring a table from a backup needs the SuperAdmin role. The audit trail lists what the restore changed and who did it.

fixes.title: Job schedule in your local time
fixes.text: Next pull and next publish times now use your browser's time zone.

fixes.title: Discovery has its own menu item
fixes.text: "Discovery: create what is new" is now a normal item under Access.
